t: 一法国军队在塞雷索尔战役中击败了哈布斯堡部队,但未能利用其胜利.
te: A French army defeats Habsburg forces at the Battle of Ceresole, but fails to exploit its victory.
dz: 1542–46年意大利战争:一法国军队在塞雷索尔战役中击败了哈布斯堡部队,但未能利用其胜利.
de: Italian War of 1542–46: A French army defeats Habsburg forces at the Battle of Ceresole, but fails to exploit its victory.

t: 英国军队将爱丁堡焚毁是"粗鲁的伍宁"的首次行动.
te: The Burning of Edinburgh by an English army is the first action of the Rough Wooing.
dz: 英国军队将爱丁堡焚毁是"粗鲁的伍宁"的首次行动.
de: The Burning of Edinburgh by an English army is the first action of the Rough Wooing.

t: 1542–46年意大利战争:第一次围攻布洛涅开始.
te: The first Siege of Boulogne begins.
dz: 1542–46年意大利战争:第一次围攻布洛涅开始.
de: Italian War of 1542–46: The first Siege of Boulogne begins.

t: 胡安·鲍蒂斯塔·帕斯泰内(Juan Bautista Pastene)的远征使智利南部的圣佩德…
te: The expedition of Juan Bautista Pastene makes landfall in San Pedro Bay, southern Chile, claiming the territory for Spa…
dz: 胡安·鲍蒂斯塔·帕斯泰内(Juan Bautista Pastene)的远征使智利南部的圣佩德罗湾登陆,为西班牙宣称领土.
de: The expedition of Juan Bautista Pastene makes landfall in San Pedro Bay, southern Chile, claiming the territory for Spain.
